Dear José,
Thank you for reaching out to eMobility Support. My name is
Francisco
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
MP / S2 170003341
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
lUkOY0
Problem Description
: ELMS is not working
Troubleshooting
:
I checked remotely and in the Router 1 there seems to be no cable connected to the WAN port.
I see that in Router 2 there is a WAN connection:
Please make sure that the connection to the ELMS (ethernet cable) is connected in Router 1 and not Router 2. After this change we will can check again the connectivity to the ELMS to see if it's fixed.
For future reference, your ticket number is
0387316
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
